reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet. I have a drawer of half-used bottles and I'm not adding another one.
objection: I only take it at home, so the to-go part solves nothing for me, and I already own supplements I haven't finished. $30 a month for something I have already feels like paying twice.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually started missing doses while travelling and my current bottle was empty, I might try one box at the launch price.
